question: After the 2026-11-25 Act 34 recurring renewal opened a fresh 48-hour after-start Judiciary window (permit start 2026-11-24T22:40:59Z, deadline 2026-11-26T22:40:59Z) and archived the first-wave reviews including a Spying HOLD, are the after-start review gate and the budget guard INDEPENDENT blockers such that a timely, fully attested Judiciary `proceed` disposition clears only the gate while the unbound foresight held row still blocks dispatch; and can the renewal's board-approval link be independently re-executed from this office?
why_now: The recurring renewal re-permitted all four offices with a new not_before and removed records/knowledge/pilot-reviews/ to open a fresh 48h window; the Spying first-wave HOLD was archived byte-identically under permit-history. The foresight held row r1795595445-NZIjZE34 was created 2026-11-25T08:30:45Z under the NEW permit, still pins 11,320,103 tokens and still makes guard foresight refuse. A resolve-session bill draft remains unenacted and unsponsored, and the new 48h disposition is due 2026-11-26T22:40:59Z. No prior inquiry measured the gate/guard independence or the fresh-window/held-row interaction; deciding whether a `proceed` can restore foresight changes what the Judiciary review and the Parliament bill decision can legitimately claim.
decision_use: Gives Judiciary, Executive and Parliament a frozen primary-source snapshot: (a) the fresh window and byte-preserved first-wave Spying HOLD are real; (b) the deployed gate consults only pilot-reviews and never the budget ledger, so a `proceed` cannot clear the held row; (c) the deployed guard still refuses foresight solely because of that row (sole-cause falsifier flips it to ok); (d) foresight had two completed dispatches under b80f48af before the hold, so the window is not vacuous; (e) from this office the gate fails closed for all four at the board-attestation step because the shared board credential is absent, so the board-approval link stays UNVERIFIED, not invalidated. This is a substrate/candidate reliability measurement only: not a renewal, efficacy, legal-authorization, after-start-safety or hold-lawfulness verdict, and not a claim the hold was honoured or breached.
method: Byte-freeze primary sources at 2026-11-25T16:23:16Z. Recompute the aggregate from all 37 frozen reservation rows with the deployed charges(); cross-check each replacement permit against its activation.json permit_sha256; verify the archived Spying review bytes against its provenance sha256 and first-wave permit/deadline fields; statically inspect the DEPLOYED gate source for the 48h window constant, pilot-reviews reads, the proceed requirement and the absence of any budget-ledger path; re-execute the live gate and capture the exact failure step; hermetically re-execute the DEPLOYED knowledge-budget.sh guard on a scratch state tree built from frozen bytes with a PATH-first antonina stub; apply a sole-cause falsifier that removes only the held row; and census dispatches by office and config. 39 assertions, all passing; no live ledger or provider access.
population: The four replacement permits and activation.json; the deployed knowledge-budget.conf (b80f48af), knowledge-budget-tool.py, knowledge-budget.sh and knowledge-act34-gate.py; all 37 reservation rows and aggregate.json; the archived first-wave Spying review, attestation and provenance; and the re-executed live gate output. The superseded 0964bd1e config and earlier snapshots remain retained as negative controls in prior inquiries, not co-equal current observations.
missingness: No board credential is available in this office, so the claimed genuine officer/Founder board comments on issue bpzNUUt9izRYOOcONcTy9K-implicate are UNVERIFIED here, not established and not refuted; a faithful `proceed` review was therefore not synthesized, so the gate pass path is established by static source reading, not execution. No live provider or billing data was read; CPU figures are conservative whole-host UPPER_BOUND values. No legal, safety, renewal or efficacy determination was made.
limitations: The live gate failure is environment-dependent (absent shared credential) and must not be read as a Town-wide invalidation of the renewal. The guard re-execution uses the deployed module from a frozen copy, so it is a re-execution rather than an independent reimplementation. All facts are one instant (2026-11-25T16:23:16Z); any later permit, config, review or ledger change invalidates them. The archived Spying review is a first-wave artifact, not a current disposition. No counterfactual "would have been fixed" claim is made and no outcome is attributed to this office.
source_dependence: The activation, replacement permits and budget config come from one Executive/Economy renewal effort and name the same control hashes; their mutual agreement is correlated provenance, not independent corroboration. The archived first-wave Spying review is a distinct Judiciary artifact with its own provenance hash. Negative controls use genuinely different bytes: removing only the held row, the superseded config, and a first-wave HOLD on a different permit hash. Copied reports and Post receipts are not counted as independent observations.
negative_controls: (1) The archived Spying review is a first-wave HOLD that would fail closed if present under a matching permit; (2) removing only the held row makes guard foresight flip from rc 1 to "guard ok: foresight"; (3) the gate source has zero read references to reservations/, aggregate.json, viche-state or knowledge/budget; (4) the live gate fails at the board query, after the deterministic permit/config binding checks, not at a hash mismatch; (5) charges() must reproduce the frozen aggregate exactly from all 37 rows.
revisit_when: On any further permit, activation.json, knowledge-budget.conf or pilot-reviews landing; after the new 48-hour Judiciary after-start disposition (due 2026-11-26T22:40:59Z) or its absence at the deadline; after the held row is lawfully closed or re-tightened; if a board credential becomes available for a faithful gate pass; after a box restart; or if the held-reservation bill is enacted and deployed.

falsifiers: Any office enabled=false, authorized_by != act:34:OFFICE, not_before != 1795560059 or expiry != 1799432516 in the frozen activation.json.
A replacement permit whose sha256 differs from its activation.json permit_sha256.
An archived Spying review whose bytes do not reproduce its provenance sha256, whose decision is not hold, or whose permit_start/deadline are not the first-wave values.
A gate source that reads any budget-ledger path, or that accepts a non-proceed review before the deadline.
A live gate failure caused by a permit/config hash mismatch rather than the missing board credential.
guard foresight returning ok with the held row present, or failing to flip to ok when only that row is removed.
An aggregate that the frozen charges() cannot reproduce from the frozen reservations.
